chunks: O you enwrapped in the cloak

key_terms.الْمُزَّمِّلُ: The enwrapped one; one who wraps himself in a cloak

ai.seo_question: What does the title Al-Muzzammil mean in the Quran?
ai.summary: This verse initiates Surah Al-Muzzammil, addressing the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) as 'Al-Muzzammil' (The Enwrapped One), a title reflecting his contemplative state during the early revelation or night prayers. Shia scholars often highlight this address as a sign of divine intimacy and the Prophet's spiritual readiness to receive the first commands of worship and vigilance.
